prompts.name: home
prompts.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset: square website hero artwork, home. Input image is the edit target. Recreate this premium monochrome editorial 3D collage faithfully with the same subjects, typography, composition, scale and generous transparent margins. CRITICAL fix: the source has crude rectangular stair-step background-removal artifacts all along object silhouettes. Completely remove ALL leftover white/gray background blocks, rectangular protrusions, matte halos and stray thin lines crossing rocks or extending outside objects. Reconstruct clean natural rock contours and perfectly straight paper/device edges with smooth antialiasing. Keep the black/ivory palette, rock pedestal and all main cards/devices and their readable text. Background: perfectly uniform solid warm ivory #f0eee9 across the entire canvas and every gap, edge-to-edge, no gradient, NO checkerboard or transparency pattern. No floor line, no cast shadow on backdrop. Keep generous margins matching the reference, object fits within center 80% of square canvas. Deliver polished square image. This is intentionally opaque to avoid masking artifacts.
